items.t: Buy Now, Pay Later: Good Alternative to Credit Cards or Dangerous Debt Trap?
items.sum: Buy now, pay later apps are an increasingly popular way to finance purchases. Here’s how they work: Companies like Affirm, AfterPay and Klarna allow you split the cost of everyday purchases, from running shoes to groceries, into several installment payments.
